_instructions: This file is the FINAL override layer. It runs after all PDFs are parsed.
Any field with a non-null value here will replace what was read from the PDFs or placeholders.
Use this when your operational reality differs from your official CIPC documents.
Set a field to null (or delete it) to stop overriding it and fall back to the PDF/placeholder.
Run generate_canvases.py after editing this file to regenerate all documents.
